boundary_model.reason: Native general 2D sprite UV/allocation tables are not yet proven. Alpha/content analysis is intentionally used only for conservative no-overflow editing, never as a claim of native allocation.
known_limitations: transparent padding owned by a native sprite may be omitted
one logical sprite with disconnected artwork may be split into multiple conservative regions
nearby components cannot be safely merged into a native slot from image content alone

future_gate: Atlas repacking, allocation enlargement, and new addressable slots remain experimental/disabled until native UV/reference ownership is recovered and rewrite coverage is proven.
